verification: owner publishes the SSH public-key fingerprint through the approved repository channel
verify annotated tag with git verify-tag --raw
compare the signer fingerprint with the owner-published fingerprint
rotation: owner creates a successor key before retiring the active key
release manifests identify the signing-key generation
revocation: owner marks a compromised key revoked and stops accepting its tags
release documentation records the affected tag range
recovery: owner maintains private recovery material separately from workstation, repository, and backup VM
recovery use is an owner-only release action
